summary.text: Brett Wynkoop is the Republican and Conservative Party nominee challenging incumbent Jo Anne Simon for NY State Assembly District 52. He ran for this seat in 2022 and 2024 and for New York City Council District 39 in 2021 and 2025, on the Conservative line in each Council race, and advanced to the 2026 general election without a contested primary.

paragraphs.text: According to the Branch candidate profile from his 2025 City Council run, he holds a bachelor's degree in nautical science from the U.S. Merchant Marine Academy and works as a senior technical resource for Wynn Data Limited.
Ran as the Conservative Party candidate for New York City Council District 39 in 2021, finishing second with 7.8% of the vote behind Shahana Hanif.
Ran for Assembly District 52 in 2022 on the Republican and Conservative lines, receiving 7.9% of the vote against Jo Anne Simon, and in 2024 on the Conservative line, receiving 5.8%.
Ran again for City Council District 39 on the Conservative line in the November 4, 2025 general election, receiving 8.7% of the vote; incumbent Shahana Hanif won.
Is the Republican and Conservative Party nominee in the November 3, 2026 general election; both party primaries were canceled.
